subject: CAIQ evidence and EU residency crosswalk for Marketplace listing
messages:
From: Eva Schultz <eva.schultz@marketplace-eu.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@cloudmarket.com
Date: 2026-08-01T14:12:00Z
Subject: CAIQ crosswalk & EU-residency evidence for marketplace listing

Hi Diego,

Thanks for agreeing to work with Marketplace EU on the listing intake. To move our compliance review forward we need a CAIQ crosswalk that maps Redwood's controls to the CSA/CAIQ framework, plus representative evidence for the following scoped items:

- Data residency guarantees and proof of EU-region-only processing for customer data
- Customer isolation / multi-tenant separation controls
- Key management (KMS/HSM) and encryption-at-rest details
- Runtime telemetry/logging (sample logs) and retention windows
- Change management and deployment attestations for inference runtime

Can you provide a first-pass crosswalk and indicate who on your side will own each artifact? Our legal/procurement team needs evidence for an intake deadline of Friday next week (2026-08-07).

Files can be uploaded to the Drive folder we shared (link below) or attached—whichever is easier. We may ask for short excerpts (screenshots or exported logs) rather than full datasets.

Thanks,
Eva Schultz\Program Manager, Marketplace Integrations
Marketplace EU

Eva, thanks — looping in Marissa (Compliance), Jonas (Infra/SRE) and Naomi (Privacy) to stitch owners and artifacts.

1) We'll drop an initial CAIQ crosswalk (mapping sheet) into the Drive by EOD today. Attached: CAIQ_initial_crosswalk.xlsx (matrix with control IDs and suggested artifacts).
2) Marissa will own evidence collection and the artifact roster.
3) Jonas will extract a 24-hour sampled runtime log and provide redacted snippets and a short README showing retention settings.
4) Naomi will prepare a short note on EU-region processing and key rotation policy excerpts.

Artifact owners and expected deliverables:
- Data residency statement (Naomi) — signed policy excerpt + dataplane region config screenshot (example: snapshots showing EU regions only)

Marissa — quick technical clarifications so the log sample meets Marketplace needs:

- Sampling window: is a 24-hour contiguous window OK or do you need week-long aggregated metrics? For privacy we prefer a short contiguous window that shows ingestion, inference, and retention trimming.
- Redaction: we'll replace tenant IDs with stable pseudonyms (tenant-001) and strip IPs. Confirm that’s acceptable.
- Format: will provide gzipped ndjson with a README describing fields + a small SQL-like query we used to extract the sample.

I'll attach a short instructions file with how to interpret the fields. ETA for upload: 2026-08-05 morning.

Attachments: log-sample-instructions.md

Jonas Weber\Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
